Trigger.Name: KEY-LISTVAL
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_count number;
 --v_local_time date;
 v_local_date date;
begin
 
 /* -- new tz function
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 v_local_date := v_local_time;
 else
 v_local_date := sysdate;
 end if;
 */
 
 v_local_date := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled, :GLOBAL.tz_offset, SYSDATE); -- new tz function
 
 if :ctrl_blk_1.s_order_no is not null
 then
 clear_form(NO_VALIDATE);
 execute_trigger('pre-form');
 end if;
 select count(*) into temp_count
 from orders od, customers cu
 where cu.customer_id = od.customer_id
 and cu.customer_type in ('RG', :export)
 and od.order_status in (:ordered, :allocated, :back_ordered)
 and od.chapter_id = :g_chapter_id
 and cu.chapter_id = :g_chapter_id
 and v_local_date between cu.eff_date
 and nvl(cu.term_date,v_local_date+1);
 if temp_count = 0
 then
 show_error_dist('3705'); -- no order to be packed
 check_package_failure;
 else
 list_values;
 end if;
 exception
 when others
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;

 and od.order_class = vc.order_class
 and od.chapter_id = vc.chapter_id

 exception

 end;
 begin
 /* -- Commented by Kishore on 04/26/2012. IM 8314
 select short_name || ', ' ||
 substr((cu.address_1 || ', ' || cu.city || ', ' ||
 cu.state || ' ' || cu.zip|| ' ' ||cu.country),1,50), nvl(out_of_state,'N')
 -- End of commented section */
 select short_name ||
 decode(cu.address_1, null, null, ', ' || cu.address_1) ||
 decode(cu.address_2, null, null, ', ' || cu.address_2) ||
 decode(cu.address_3, null, null, ', ' || cu.address_3) ||
 decode(cu.city, null, null, ', ' || cu.city) ||

 and od.customer_id = cu.customer_id
 and od.consignee_id = cu.consignee_id
 and od.chapter_id = cu.chapter_id
 and od.chapter_id = :g_chapter_id
 and v_local_date between cu.eff_date and nvl(term_date, v_local_date + 1);
 exception

 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
end;

procedure calculate_price is
 temp_price number;
begin
 -- on substitution, charge customer with lower price
 -- set price with packed product type and tier
 --
 get_product_price (:products.product_code, :products.exp_date,
 :products.tier, :order.customer_id, temp_price);

 --

 if :products.ord_product_type is not null
 then
 get_price_by_type(:products.ord_product_type, :products.exp_date,
 :order.customer_id, temp_price);
 if temp_price < :products.product_price
 then
 :products.product_price := temp_price;
 end if;
 end if;
 --
 -- check if substitute with an lower price tier
 --
 if :products.ord_tier is not null
 then
 get_product_price (:products.product_code, :products.exp_date,
 :products.ord_tier, :order.customer_id,
 temp_price);
 if temp_price < :products.product_price
 then
 :products.product_price := temp_price;
 end if;
 end if;
end;

procedure update_order_status is
 temp_count number;
 temp_req_qty number;

 :Global.status_changed := 'FALSE';
 --
 -- get order quantity
 begin
 select required_qty - nvl(canceled_qty,0) - nvl(system_cancel_qty,0),
 item_status

 from order_items

 --

 if temp_count >= temp_req_qty

 :Global.status_changed := 'TRUE';
 update order_items

 program_id = :banner.prog_name

select ap.product_code, product_short_name 
from vserv_products vp, active_products ap 
where chapter_id = :g_chapter_id 
and unit_id = :products.unit_id 
and substr(ap.product_code ,1,5) = vp.product_code and 
unit_scheme_type = decode(length(ap.product_code),5,'C','8','I') 
and vp.inv_product_type = :request_product_type

 )
 )
order by vp.product_code
